name: Climate & Energy
description: For climate analysts, energy investors and sustainability teams tracking the transition end to end, from emissions science to grid build out. Global coverage with a deliberate India lens on renewables and policy.

themes.label: Climate Science & Impacts
themes.hint: Measured or modelled physical change: temperature and emissions records, attribution studies, IPCC and journal findings, ice, ocean and forest data, and extreme weather framed as a climate event with damages.

themes.label: Policy & Diplomacy
themes.hint: Rules and pledges: COP and UNFCCC negotiations, NDCs, carbon pricing and border adjustment, subsidies and tax credits, permitting reform, disclosure mandates, and litigation against governments or majors.

themes.label: Renewables & Storage
themes.hint: Building clean supply: solar, wind, hydro, nuclear and geothermal projects, auctions and tariffs, batteries and long duration storage, manufacturing capacity, and module or cell price moves.

themes.label: Fossil Fuels & Transition
themes.hint: The incumbent system winding down or defending itself: oil, gas, coal and LNG supply, refinery and pipeline decisions, plant retirements and stranded assets, methane leaks, and majors' capex shifting or not shifting.

themes.label: Grid & Demand
themes.hint: Delivery and consumption rather than generation: transmission and interconnection queues, grid reliability and blackouts, data centre and industrial load growth, EV charging, heat pumps, efficiency and demand response.

themes.label: Climate Finance & Carbon Markets
themes.hint: Money moving: green bonds and transition finance, climate funds and loss and damage pledges, insurance repricing, carbon credit quality disputes and offset registries, and cleantech investment or bankruptcy.

themes.label: India Energy
themes.hint: The Indian market specifically: MNRE and CEA decisions, SECI and state auctions, discom finances and PPAs, coal and captive power, rooftop and open access rules, and domestic manufacturing incentives such as PLI and ALMM.
